features.name: Hatch Memorial Shell
features.description: The Hatch Shell is on the river side of the Esplanade near the Arthur Fiedler Footbridge. Concerts and major celebrations can close paths and radically change access.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Hatch Memorial Shell at Charles River Esplanade

features.name: Esplanade Playspace
features.description: The Playspace is west of the Hatch Shell near the river paths. Use the nearest pedestrian bridge and supervise children around bicycles, lagoons, and the river edge.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Esplanade Playspace at Charles River Esplanade

features.name: Community Boating and docks
features.description: Community Boating is near the east Esplanade by the Longfellow Bridge. Lessons, rentals, dock access, weather holds, and eligibility use the operator's schedule.

details.imageAlt: Community Boating and docks at Charles River Esplanade

features.name: Esplanade lagoons and river paths
features.description: The paved river paths and lagoon bridges extend well beyond one pin. Pick an out-and-back distance and stay right around runners, cyclists, and narrow bridges.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Esplanade lagoons and river paths at Charles River Esplanade

features.name: Stoneman Playground
features.description: Stoneman Playground is in the western Esplanade between the Fairfield Street and Massachusetts Avenue footbridges. It has separate toddler and older-child play zones but no direct visitor parking.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Stoneman Playground at Charles River Esplanade

features.name: Teddy Ebersol's Red Sox Fields
features.description: These athletic fields are at the eastern Esplanade near the Blossom Street footbridge and Museum of Science. Games, permits, and maintenance can limit casual field use.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Teddy Ebersol's Red Sox Fields at Charles River Esplanade

features.name: Arthur Fiedler Footbridge
features.description: This pedestrian bridge crosses Storrow Drive near the Hatch Shell and Esplanade Playspace. It is a primary arrival route, but its ramps and approaches add distance and there is no parking at the bridge.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Arthur Fiedler Footbridge at Charles River Esplanade

features.name: Lotta Fountain
features.description: The Lotta Fountain is a historic dog-friendly drinking fountain near the Esplanade paths west of the Hatch Shell. Treat it as a small landmark and water stop, not a dependable human drinking fountain or restroom.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Lotta Fountain at Charles River Esplanade
